t: A Deccan empire founded in 753 by Dantidurga, who overthrew his Chalukya overlords; its capital from Amoghavarsha I was Manyakheta.
Its armies reached the Ganges plain and Kanchi, and Arab writers counted its king, the Balhara, among the world’s four great kings.
It carved the Kailasa temple at Ellora and fostered the earliest surviving Kannada literature and major Jain scholarship.
dyk: The last Rashtrakuta claimant, Indra IV, ended his life in 982 by sallekhana, the Jain ritual fast to death, at the hilltop shrine of Shravanabelagola.
ev: Dantidurga defeats the Chalukya king Kirtivarman II
Dhruva defeats the Pratihara and Pala kings in the Ganga–Yamuna doab
Govinda III campaigns from the Ganges plain to Kanchi
Amoghavarsha I begins a 64-year reign and later founds Manyakheta
Krishna III defeats the Cholas at the Battle of Takkolam
The Paramara king Siyaka II sacks Manyakheta
Tailapa II overthrows Karka II and founds the Western Chalukya Empire

f.capital: Ellora region; later Mayurakhandi; then Manyakheta, founded by Amoghavarsha I
